capabilities: Display folder notes as cards in status-based columns
Update the status frontmatter property by dragging cards between columns
Configure columns with colors, order, visibility, and default values
Show custom frontmatter fields like assignee, priority, or due date on cards
Open the underlying note when a card is clicked
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in board view for managing notes as workflow cards, so users can't visualize or change note statuses without editing frontmatter manually.
summary: Kanban board view that sorts notes from a folder into columns by a frontmatter status property and updates it via drag and drop.
